review_locator: PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication
primary_title: Human Astrocytes: Secretome Profiles of Cytokines and Chemokines
decision_basis: The neuroglial-signaling review cites the human astrocyte secretome study reporting increased IL-6 protein in conditioned medium after combined IL-1beta and TNF-alpha stimulation.
limitations_preserved: IL-6 protein was increased in conditioned medium after combined IL-1beta/TNF-alpha stimulation of highly purified human astrocytes; preserve the combined-treatment and human astrocyte context, distinguish released IL-6 protein from IL6 transcription, and do not infer a defined receptor mechanism or terminal-TF effect.
